integrity: The complete proof and a finite exact-arithmetic corroboration are supplied. Prior Liu--Zhu specialization is excluded from originality. Self-review only, no independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: For all n>=2 and coprime B<=A<=nB, only affine full-dimensional cone charts of the trace-zero box-section face fan. Omits a degenerate lower face at A=nB. Does not describe arbitrary local rings or global class groups. Wu full text was not inspected, leaving an unquantified publication-priority risk.
title: Complete affine divisor class groups across a toric Fano alpha spectrum
